title: RAS Model Setup: R3 to R2 Projection
content: Model: L1 local meaning field simplified as 3D Euclidean space R^3 with meaning density rho(x,y,z). L0 physical observation screen is 2D plane R^2. Projection map pi: R^3 -> R^2 defined as linear projection pi(x,y,z) = (x,y). Purpose: calculate local curvature (heat tax) and global topological deficit (meaning void) when projecting non-trivial topological meaning network (CMN) and gradient field from 3D to 2D.

title: Step 1: Construct 3D Meaning Field and Network
content: Meaning density field rho: localized meaning source with Gaussian distribution along z-axis, uniform in x-y plane. rho(z) = exp(-z^2). Gradient field: grad_rho = (0, 0, -2z*exp(-z^2)), meaning flow entirely along z-axis. CMN: simplicial complex K with two independent rings. Ring 1: physical ring at z=0 plane (nodes A,B,C). Ring 2: vertical ring parallel to z-axis (nodes D,E,F), existence depends entirely on third dimension.

title: Step 2: Projection and Geometric Distortion
content: Field projection: After projection to R^2, only see rho(x,y) = rho(x,y,0) = 1. Flat distribution, gradient zero. Total meaning field strength in R^3: |grad_rho|^2 = 4z^2*exp(-2z^2). This energy cannot be expressed by 2D plane gradient, becomes lost kinetic energy = heat tax. Heat tax density gamma = kappa * integral_{-inf}^{inf} 4z^2*exp(-2z^2) dz = kappa * sqrt(pi/2).

title: Step 3: Network Projection and Topological Distortion
content: Ring 1 (physical): All nodes at z=0 plane, perfectly preserved after projection. Homology group H1 Betti number beta_1 = 1. Ring 2 (vertical): Nodes D,E,F form ring in R^3. After projection to R^2, three points collapse to single point due to identical (x,y) coordinates. Original ring topology completely crushed, beta_1 drops to 0. Conclusion: Projection causes topological deficit. Pre-projection beta_1(K)=2, post-projection beta_1(pi(K))=1. Lost independent ring = meaning void = invisible structure connecting different things globally in low-D physical world.

title: RAS Physical Interpretation
content: Riemann metric and curvature (heat tax): Projection-induced local meaning flow gradient loss is source of S_munu (meaning field stress-energy tensor). Produces extra gravity corresponding to local heat tax density gamma. Alexandrov topology (dark matter network): Projection-induced global topological ring deficit is source of dark matter network effect. Crushed vertical ring appears to 2D observers as skeleton maintaining galaxy periphery gravity but invisible. Core insight: Heat tax is friction of meaning flow; dark matter is afterimage of meaning network; physical world is low-D projection slice of high-D topological skeleton.
